BANOFFEE . . . 
Creme de Leite Fresco,
+ Banana + Leite Moça Cozido + Bolacha maizena e manteiga.
Uma Sobremesa Deliciosa que Vc precisa Fazer.
Anota e fazzz e depoiiiis me conta 😘

Ingredientes 👇
Numa Forma Removível  25x5cm.

1° Passo 
400 grs Bolachas maizena triturada
200 grs Manteiga S/ sal .
Mistur tudo e divida essa massa , para o funda da forma e Laterais também.
Reserve na Geladeira. 
Eu não coloquei pra Assar no forno, mas 
Se vc kiser pode colocar pra assar no forno  fogo 180° por 15 mints.

2° Passo 
 Cozinhei e Usei quase as duas Latas. 
2 Latas de Leite Moça, na panela de pressão por 35mints.

3° Passo 
Na Batedeira 
500 grs de Creme de Leite Fresco , bem Gelado
100 grs de Açúcar Confeiteiro peneirado. 
1 colher de chá Extrato de Baunilha .
Bater até dar ponto de Chantily. 

De 6 a 8 bananas depende dos tamanhos da ,🍌
Coloquei inteiras , para o corte da Banoffe ficar +
 bonitas.

4° Passo

150 grs de Chocolate nobre Meio Amargo picados , por cima do Creme de leite Fresco, maiss se VC kiser pode colocar Canela,  eu particularmente não gosto de colocar Canela.

Outra Sugestão VC pode substituir o Creme de Leite Fresco, por Chantily  Amélia, ou Nata ,  eu Prefiro Creme de  Leite Fresco.

😋 Banoffee Weetabix Cheesecake 😋

Serves 1
Ready in 10 minutes (plus overnight chilling)

What you need:

2 Weetabix
2 tbsp fat-free natural yogurt
160g no-added-sugar fat-free toffee yogurt
1 banana, sliced
1 level tsp ChocShot

What you do:

1. Put the Weetabix in a bowl and crush them with your hands or a fork. Add the natural yogurt and mix together.

2. Spoon the mixture into the base of a dessert glass and press down firmly.

3. Pour the toffee yogurt over the base to form a second layer. Cover and chill overnight.

4. Top with the sliced banana and ChocShot to serve.

BANOFFEE WARRIOR CRUNCH PROTEIN BAR 🍌🍫

248kcals
20grams of protein

As soon as you opened the wrapper a strong banana aroma hit me!! 🍌💪🏼 I just knew this was gonna be delicious 🤤 

The protein mass was dense and chewy - a bit more dense to what I usually like as the mass had a slight graininess too. 

I was immediately hit with a strong, intense sweet banana 🍌 flavour. 
It legit tasted like a sweet caramelised banana!! It did have that banana foam candy taste which was fun and unique 🍬

There was a layer of super gooey and sweet caramel which complimented the banana flavour. Throughout there were crunchy pieces which gave the bar such a fun texture. 

The white chocolate had a sweet caramelised flavour - it was so smooth and buttery!! 😍 This went SO well with the banana and caramel - I loved this flavour combination. 

Flavour accuracy - 9/10 Honestly spot on!! The only thing I would change would be making the mass a tad bit softer. 

Would I buy this again? Yes!! The flavour was super strong and accurate.
